name: ahastation-local-cli
description: Standalone Local CLI Workspace with Voice ASR Input extracted from AhaStation

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run typecheck:electron
scripts.build:electron: node scripts/clean-dist-electron.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/copy-preloads.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/fetch-speaker-model.mjs --optional && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: node scripts/fetch-speaker-model.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:dmg: node scripts/fetch-speaker-model.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-macos-signing.mjs
